question: What auspicious deception of time does the speaker now wish to hear?
premises: The speaker wishes to hear now.
The object is deception of time.
inference: The verse requests instruction on an auspicious way of overcoming or deceiving time.
uncertainties: Whether vañcanaṃ means deception, avoidance, or transcendence of time.
plain_english: Now I wish to hear the auspicious deception of time.
